limitations: Single frontal reference. Cranium, ears in depth, neck, hands, garment cut and rear hairstyle are inferred.
Facial proportions, iris pigmentation and smile are sculpted approximations. The skin and lip transitions are smoother than the photograph.
Hair is a fixed groom with native curves over supporting locks. The crown and long waves group into more regular sections than real hair.
Wool is a modeled garment with tiled yarn color and relief. Individual sweater stitches are shaded.
No production rig, cloth simulation or lower body. Head shape keys and separate posed eyes, hair and garments require coordinated edits for a new pose.
Café and lighting are reconstructed suggestions.
